title: Google sign-in needs your OAuth client id (about 10 min)

owner_note.text: Real Google sign-in has never run because no OAuth client id is set. Create a Web OAuth client in Google Cloud Console (origins staging.lew42.com and lew42.com), paste its id into GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID in worker/wrangler.jsonc, and set ADMIN_EMAIL. Steps 1-3: worker/readme.md, 'What the owner must do'. Until then the forms sign-in button is a mock.
